modmenu.descriptionTranslation.stashligh: Caches chest contents and lets you search through them via an in-game menu.
render.stashlight.highlight.incorrectDim: Container is in a different dimension
screen.stashlight.highlightInventory.too: Highlight every container that holds an item from your inventory
screen.stashlight.clearHighlights.toolti: Remove all highlights, tracer lines and material slot highlights
screen.stashlight.highlightMaterials.too: Use the last opened Litematica material list (including its filters), or the active material HUD. Replace markers with all matching cached containers in this dimension; highlight matching slots when opened. Ignores Stashlight search filters.
render.stashlight.materials.notInstalled: Install Litematica to use schematic material highlighting
render.stashlight.materials.noList: Open a Litematica material list or enable its material HUD first
render.stashlight.materials.empty: The selected material list is empty after filtering
render.stashlight.materials.incompatible: Reading this Litematica material list failed; see the game log for details
render.stashlight.materials.marked: Selected %s material types; highlighted %s cached containers. Matching container slots are now highlighted.
